fact: The NCRST authors state Namibia lacks comprehensive data protection and cybersecurity legislation and frameworks for AI governance.
Minister Emma Theofelus said consultations on the draft Cybercrime Bill, which targets image-based abuse and malicious use of deepfake technology, resume in February 2026.
The Namibian Presidency said on 7 October 2025 that a deepfake video of the president promoting an investment scheme is not only unethical but criminal under Namibian laws, without naming a law.
